description: The most common form of psoriasis, a chronic relapsing inflammatory skin disease.
causes: Immune-mediated inflammatory disease with genetic and environmental contributions

appearance.general: Symmetrical, sharply demarcated thickened plaques with overlying scale.
appearance.light_skin: Plaques may appear pink or red with silver-white scale.
appearance.dark_skin: Plaques may appear brown, purple, or grey with scale.

warning_signs: Widespread rapidly worsening disease or systemic illness requires medical assessment.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss joint pain or stiffness because psoriasis can be associated with psoriatic arthritis.
